This regex only matches flags beginning with a single dash (e.g., '-bar') but not double dashes (e.g., '--bar'). To fix the bug, the matching logic for flag arguments should be updated to allow for one or more dashes, so both '-flag' and '--flag' are highlighted. No class definitions are relevant to this bug; only the PS_ARGUMENTS function/constant is directly responsible for the bug.
